overview: In the afternoon you looked at the sheet. The call was still on it. You did not strike Nurse, and you did not write her a line lower. The bundle stayed tied on the other side of the board.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the call and left it standing.

assets.name: the vial speech
assets.disposition: Read the Nurse's call on the sheet
